claim: A mathematical model can predict the path walkers take through a rugged landscape.
source: A mathematical model can predict the path walkers take through a rugged landscape, including the tendency of people to avoid paths that are too steep, even if it means going farther.
evidence: This is stated as a capability of the mathematical model described in the manuscript abstract.

claim: People tend to avoid paths that are too steep when walking through a rugged landscape.
source: A mathematical model can predict the path walkers take through a rugged landscape, including the tendency of people to avoid paths that are too steep, even if it means going farther.
evidence: This behavioral tendency is explicitly mentioned as something the mathematical model can predict.

claim: People are willing to travel farther distances to avoid steep paths.
source: A mathematical model can predict the path walkers take through a rugged landscape, including the tendency of people to avoid paths that are too steep, even if it means going farther.
